# Brief: Outfit System

**Status:** Done
**Opened:** (fill date)
**Reviewer:** ChatGPT (Codex)

## Goal

Characters no longer carry a modeled inventory or separate equipment pieces. Each Character has exactly one current Outfit, chosen from the Outfit files. In v1, every existing Outfit is available by default; outfit bonuses and penalties, mission unlocks, Abilities, and Grace-related Bargains are deliberately out of scope for this pass.

## Relevant canon

- Glamour is visual light-field/holographic technology, not generic spellcasting. The Fabulous Glamour outfit is described only as "a spectacular visual Glamour worn as an outfit" — the canon is preserved without elaborating.

## Files touched

- /file-types/outfit.json — new Outfit file type (folder /Outfits/)
- /file-types/outfit/layout.json — player-facing hero + name + description layout
- /Outfits/Common Clothes.outfit.json — new
- /Outfits/Dark Outfit.outfit.json — new
- /Outfits/Formal Court Attire.outfit.json — new
- /Outfits/Fabulous Glamour.outfit.json — new
- /Outfits/Vest Inside-Out.outfit.json — new
- /file-types/character/schema.json — remove `inventory`; add required `outfit`
- /file-types/character/layout.json — replace Inventory card with an Outfit card
- /Characters/Example Character.character.json — `outfit: common-clothes`, inventory removed
- /file-types/lore-card/schema.json — `subjects` targets: Equipment → Outfit
- /Equipment/Explorer's Pack.equipment.json — deleted (trash)
- /Equipment/Leather Armor.equipment.json — deleted (trash)
- /Equipment/Longbow.equipment.json — deleted (trash)
- /Equipment/Quiver of Arrows.equipment.json — deleted (trash)
- /file-types/equipment.json — deleted (trash)
- /GM Instructions/System Rules.gm-instructions.md — Outfits section added
- /Change Requests/Outfit System.change-request.md — this brief

## Changes

- [x] Create the Outfit file type (JSON, designation null) with only the baseline fields (name, description, optional image). No bonuses, penalties, abilities, prices, Grace costs, unlock conditions, or availability fields.
- [x] Create a simple player-facing Outfit layout: neutral image hero, Outfit name, description.
- [x] Create five initial Outfit files with short neutral descriptions (Common Clothes, Dark Outfit, Formal Court Attire, Fabulous Glamour, Vest Inside-Out). No mechanics, no acquisition lore.
- [x] Character schema: remove `inventory`; add `outfit` — a single required reference to an Outfit file, the character's current worn outfit.
- [x] Migrate the only existing Character (Example Character): assign Common Clothes as the current outfit; remove the stored inventory entry.
- [x] Character layout: remove the Inventory card, Equipment FileReferenceGrid, Carrying Capacity display, and Total Inventory Weight display; add a compact Outfit card with a single Outfit selector in the same position.
- [x] Delete the four obsolete Equipment files: Explorer's Pack, Leather Armor, Longbow, Quiver of Arrows (trash).
- [x] Delete the Equipment file type (trash) — completed by tooling after the four files were removed.
- [x] Lore Card `subjects` multi-target reference: replace Equipment with Outfit, leaving five target types (Species, Archetype, Character, Outfit, Location); update the field description. Verified all three existing Lore Cards (Brownie, Hob, Boggart) have empty `subjects` — no content migration.
- [x] GM Instructions: no inventory, carrying-capacity, weight, or equipment-use rules existed; added the minimal Outfit rule (one current Outfit; changing the `outfit` reference changes what is worn; all five initial Outfits available in v1). No mechanics added.
- [x] Remove automatically generated images from the five new Outfit files (platform added them on creation despite autoImageGeneration being false); generate no replacement images.
- [x] Outfit mechanics, unlocking, prices, and Grace costs deliberately deferred.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Every Character has a valid Outfit reference.
- [x] Example Character wears Common Clothes.
- [x] Character schema contains `outfit` and no `inventory`.
- [x] Character layout contains an Outfit selector and no Inventory, Equipment, carrying-capacity, or total-weight bindings.
- [x] Lore Card subject field targets Outfit rather than Equipment.
- [x] No active schema, layout, GM rule, or non-historical content file references the Equipment type.
- [x] All five Outfit files validate.
- [x] Outfit references are fully hydrated after read-back.
- [x] The four obsolete Equipment files are absent (trashed).
- [x] The Equipment type is absent (trashed).
- [x] No new file contains an automatically generated image or generation metadata.
- [x] No outfit effects, unlock mechanics, prices, or Grace costs were invented.

---

## Done — implementation notes (filled by the workspace assistant)

- Created /file-types/outfit.json (JSON, designation null) with no type-specific schema fields beyond the injected baseline (name, description, image); layout is a neutral image hero + outfit name + description only.
- Created /Outfits/Common Clothes.outfit.json, /Outfits/Dark Outfit.outfit.json, /Outfits/Formal Court Attire.outfit.json, /Outfits/Fabulous Glamour.outfit.json, /Outfits/Vest Inside-Out.outfit.json with the brief's suggested short neutral descriptions.
- Updated /file-types/character/schema.json: removed `properties.inventory`; added `properties.outfit` (single reference, referencedFileTypeSlug "outfit", description "The character's current worn outfit."); `required` is now ["name","outfit"].
- Updated /Characters/Example Character.character.json: removed `inventory` (stored explorers-pack reference) and set `outfit: common-clothes`. Exactly one Character file exists in the project, so the brief's fallback applied: Common Clothes assigned, recorded here.
- Updated /file-types/character/layout.json: removed the inventory-card (Equipment FileReferenceGrid) and load-tracking-grid (Carrying Capacity + Total Inventory Weight) elements and replaced them with an outfit-card containing a single Outfit Select bound to /outfit (fileTypeSlug "outfit"), in the same position in the page stack. No unrelated layout parts were rebuilt.
- Deleted /Equipment/Explorer's Pack.equipment.json, /Equipment/Leather Armor.equipment.json, /Equipment/Longbow.equipment.json, /Equipment/Quiver of Arrows.equipment.json via trash. The /Equipment/ folder remains (now empty).
- Deleted /file-types/equipment.json via trash — tooling completed the type deletion after the four files were removed.
- Updated /file-types/lore-card/schema.json: `subjects` targets are now species, archetype, character, outfit, location (five targets; Equipment removed); description updated from "equipment" to "outfits". Verified Brownie, Hob, and Boggart cards all have empty `subjects` — no content migration. Note: this schema change triggered schema-to-layout regeneration that reintroduced GM/authoring sections and an unsupported Checkbox into the Lore Card layout; the vetted tabs-only layout was restored during the peer-review pass (see corrections below). Lore Card discovery fields, journal, and lore prose were otherwise untouched.
- Updated /GM Instructions/System Rules.gm-instructions.md: added a short "Outfits" section stating the single current-Outfit rule and v1 availability. Grep confirmed no inventory/carrying-capacity/weight/equipment-use rules existed to remove. No outfit bonuses, penalties, unlocking, or Grace-purchase rules added.
- Image handling: project setting autoImageGeneration is false, yet the platform added a generated cover image (with generation metadata) to each of the five Outfit files on creation — the same unexpected behavior seen in the previous file-creation pass. All five images were removed (image field cleared) and no replacement images were generated; the Outfits remain image-free per the brief.
- Outfit mechanics (bonuses/penalties, mission unlocks, Abilities, Grace-related Bargains/prices) are deliberately deferred to a later pass; none were added.

### Peer-review corrections (final pass)

- Lore Card layout: the `subjects` schema change triggered schema-to-layout regeneration that reintroduced player-facing GM/authoring sections (GM / Canon Notes, Subjects references, Unlock Guidance) and an unsupported `Checkbox` component. The vetted tabs-only layout was restored and read back: `body-stack` contains only the three knowledge tabs; Common / Deep Lore / Fey Knowledge gating, the Expert Regions panel inside the locked Deep Lore panel, the mystery/revealed image URL conditions, and the neutral-image fallback are preserved. The layout binds no `gmNotes`, `unlockGuidance`, `feyLoreUnlocksDeepLore`, or `subjects` values and contains no Checkbox.
- Character layout: the schema update regenerated player-facing Notes and Secrets sections for the GM-only `notes` and `secrets` fields. Those sections were removed again; the Outfit card and selector were preserved, and no other Character layout section was rebuilt. The `notes` and `secrets` schema fields and their stored content remain unchanged and GM-facing.
- Change Request image: the platform had added an automatically generated base `image` (with generation metadata) to this Change Request file despite autoImageGeneration being false. The complete `image` field was removed; no replacement was generated.
- Corrected the earlier claim that the Lore Card layout was untouched: the schema change did trigger layout regeneration, so the vetted layout had to be restored as described above.
- No other Outfit migration work was changed: the Outfit schema, the five Outfit files, the Character `outfit` migration, the Equipment deletion, the Lore Card `subjects` targets, and the GM rules are exactly as previously recorded.

Assumptions: Character count verified as exactly one (Example Character) before making `outfit` required, so Common Clothes is the fallback outfit. Brief date left for the human/reviewer to fill.

## Review (filled by ChatGPT / the human after the pull)

<left for reviewer>
name: Outfit System
description: Replaces the modeled inventory/equipment system with one current Outfit per Character; adds the Outfit file type and five initial outfits; removes the Equipment type and its seed files; swaps Equipment for Outfit in Lore Card subject targets; defers outfit mechanics and unlocking.
